title: Tenon commands
about: What every Tenon command takes, as JSON Schema (draft 2020-12). Units: millimetres and radians, unless a parameter says otherwise. Within a version the schemas only grow (new commands, new optional parameters, wider types); anything that could break a caller comes with a new version. Generated by `tenon-cli commands --schema`; see docs/schemas/README.md.

face_ref.description: A persistent reference to a face: what model.face_ref returns. It names the face by the feature and sketch curve that made it, and keeps a fingerprint to find it again when the name is lost.

edge_ref.description: A persistent reference to an edge: what model.edge_ref returns. It names the edge by the two faces it lies between.

commands.label: Project Geometry
commands.description: sketch; edge or edges: edge references (model.edge_ref), or face: a face reference whose edges are all projected. The edges are shown in the sketch as reference geometry: it follows the part, other geometry is constrained and dimensioned to it, and it bounds profiles. Only edges made before the sketch; straight and circular ones. flat: true (Project Flat Pattern, in a sketch on a side of a sheet metal part) shows each edge where it lies with the sheet laid flat from the sketch's face, so the faces beyond a bend can be drawn on for a cut across it. geometry: what each of `edges` is on the sketch plane (for callers without a kernel). Returns the entities, and why any edge of a face was left out

commands.label: Sheet Metal Defaults
commands.description: Makes the part a sheet metal part and sets its rule. Sizes, each a number (mm) or an equation: thickness, bend_radius, relief_width, relief_depth, min_remnant, corner_size, gap, and k_factor (0 to 1); they are the parameters Thickness, BendRadius, BendReliefWidth, BendReliefDepth, MinimumRemnant, CornerReliefSize, GapSize and KFactor. relief: "straight" | "round" (the cut beside a bend narrower than its edge); corner: "round" | "square" | "trim" (the relief where two bends meet at a corner, centred where their centre lines cross). Returns the rule as it now is

relief.description: the shape of the cut beside a bend narrower than its edge

relief_depth.description: how far it goes past the bend

min_remnant.description: less sheet than this left beside a relief is cut away too

corner.description: the shape of the cut where two bends meet

gap.description: the gap left where walls meet (Miter Gap)

k_factor.description: where in the thickness a bend keeps its length, 0 to 1

commands.label: Sheet Metal Rule
commands.description: the part's sheet metal rule and sizes, or sheet_metal: false

commands.label: Face
commands.description: sketch; regions; flip (the thickness goes behind the sketch plane); operation: "join" (default) | "new_body". A closed profile made one Thickness thick

sketch.description: the sketch: its feature id, as sketch.create returns it

regions.description: the closed regions of the sketch to use, each as sketch.info lists it under `select`: [curve ids], or {left, right, nth} for one region of a divided sketch (default: every outer region)

flip.description: give the sheet its thickness on the other side of the sketch (default false)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Flange
commands.description: edges: [edge references] (straight edges of the sheet's rim; the flange bends towards the side each is on); height; angle (rad, default a quarter turn); datum: "outer" (default: the height is overall) | "inner" | "tangent"; position: "inside" (default: the flange's outer face goes through the edge) | "adjacent" (the bend starts at the edge) | "outside" | "tangent"; flip (bend to the other side); radius (default BendRadius); width (in the middle of the edge) or offsets: [from the start, from the end] (default: the whole edge). Edges that meet at a corner get the rule's corner relief, and their walls are brought together to leave the rule's gap (miter: false leaves each wall ending where its bend does). Edges on the tops of two walls either side of a corner are mitred the same way: lips turned in over a tray do not share its corners

edges.description: the edges of the sheet to bend walls up from

angle.description: how far the wall is bent up (default a right angle)

datum.description: what the height is measured from (default outer: over all)

position.description: where the bend lies relative to the edge (default inside)

flip.description: bend to the other side of the sheet (default false)

radius.description: the inside bend radius (default: the rule's BendRadius)

miter.description: mitre walls of this feature where they meet (default true)

width.description: how wide it is, centred on the edge (default: the whole edge)

offsets.description: [from the start of the edge, from its end] in place of `width`

seam.description: how the two walls meet (default symmetric)

overlap.description: how much of the thickness the overlapping wall covers, 0 to 1 (default 1)

gap.description: the gap left between the walls (default: the rule's GapSize)

relief.description: the corner relief's shape (default: the rule's)

relief_size.description: the corner relief's size (default: the rule's CornerReliefSize)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Hem
commands.description: edges: [edge references] (straight edges of the sheet's rim; the hem folds towards the side each is on); type: "single" (default: folded flat back over the sheet) | "double" (folded over twice) | "rolled" (a bend and nothing after it) | "teardrop" (rolled past half a turn, then straight back down to the sheet); gap (single, double: between the layers; default half a Thickness) and length (overall, from the outside of the fold; default four Thicknesses); radius (rolled, teardrop: inside; default BendRadius) and angle (rad; default 270 degrees rolled, 190 teardrop); flip (fold to the other side); width or offsets: [from the start, from the end] as for sheet.flange

gap.description: single, double: the gap inside the fold (default half the thickness)

length.description: single, double: how long the hem is, over all (default four times the thickness)

radius.description: rolled, teardrop: the inside radius (default: the rule's BendRadius)

angle.description: rolled, teardrop: how far round (default 270 and 190 degrees)

flip.description: fold to the other side (default false)

width.description: how wide it is, centred on the edge (default: the whole edge)

offsets.description: [from the start of the edge, from its end] in place of `width`

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Contour Flange
commands.description: sketch (an open profile: lines and arcs end to end; corners between lines become bends, an arc is a bend as drawn); distance (how far the profile is pushed out of its plane); direction: "default" | "flipped" | "symmetric"; position: "default" (the sheet goes on the inside of the profile's first corner) | "flipped" | "symmetric"; radius (inside, of the bends made at corners; default BendRadius); operation: "join" (default) | "new_body". Or along edges of the sheet: edges: [edge references] (straight edges of its rim; the sketch is square to the first and the profile starts at that edge, the side of the sheet the edge is on running on into it, with a bend where it leaves at an angle, for which the sheet is cut back) with width or offsets as for sheet.flange; distance, direction and position then say nothing

sketch.description: the sketch of the open profile: lines and arcs end to end

distance.description: how wide the strip is, when it is not along `edges`

direction.description: which way from the sketch the strip is pushed

position.description: which side of the profile the sheet's thickness is on

edges.description: edges of the sheet to run the profile along, the first of them where the profile is drawn

radius.description: the inside bend radius (default: the rule's BendRadius)

width.description: how wide it is, centred on the edge (default: the whole edge)

offsets.description: [from the start of the edge, from its end] in place of `width`

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Corner Seam
commands.description: edges: [two edge references]: the edge at the end of each of two faces that are bent up from one sheet and come together at a square corner (flanges made apart: edges of one flange close their own corners); the first face's, then the second's. Their bends are ended where the two bend lines cross, the faces brought together, and the corner relieved. seam: "symmetric" (default: both stop the gap apart) | "overlap" (the first runs across the end of the second) | "reverse_overlap"; overlap (how much of the other's thickness is covered, 0 to 1; default 1); gap (default GapSize); relief: "round" | "square" | "trim" and relief_size (default: the rule's)

edges.description: an edge of each of the two walls that meet

seam.description: how the two walls meet (default symmetric)

overlap.description: how much of the thickness the overlapping wall covers, 0 to 1 (default 1)

gap.description: the gap left between the walls (default: the rule's GapSize)

relief.description: the corner relief's shape (default: the rule's)

relief_size.description: the corner relief's size (default: the rule's CornerReliefSize)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Corner Rip
commands.description: edges: [edge references]: each the edge of a square corner where two walls of the sheet meet with no seam between them (the corner of a shelled box, say), its outside edge or its inside one. The corner is opened along the edge, as far as the edge goes: seam: "symmetric" (default: both walls stop where their inner faces are the gap apart, and the corner between them goes) | "overlap" (the first wall keeps the corner and the second stops the gap short of it; the first is the wall whose face the edge reference names first) | "reverse_overlap"; overlap (how much of the other wall's thickness the wall that keeps the corner covers, 0 to 1; default 1); gap (default GapSize). Bends are not made of the sharp edges that are left

edges.description: the corner's edges: outside or inside edges where two walls meet square

seam.description: how the two walls meet (default symmetric)

overlap.description: how much of the thickness the overlapping wall covers, 0 to 1 (default 1)

gap.description: the gap left between the walls (default: the rule's GapSize)

relief.description: the corner relief's shape (default: the rule's)

relief_size.description: the corner relief's size (default: the rule's CornerReliefSize)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Cut Across Bend
commands.description: sketch (on a flat face of the sheet, its profile of lines, arcs and circles drawn as on the flat pattern: past an edge of the face that is a bend line it lies on the bend, then on the face beyond); regions; distance (how deep from the side the sketch is on; default and at most Thickness: through). The profile is cut out of every face and bend it lies on with the sheet laid flat from the sketch's face, so the cut goes round the bends and is the profile in the flat pattern

sketch.description: the sketch: its feature id, as sketch.create returns it

regions.description: the closed regions of the sketch to use, each as sketch.info lists it under `select`: [curve ids], or {left, right, nth} for one region of a divided sketch (default: every outer region)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Cut Normal
commands.description: sketch (on any plane that looks at the sheet: a face of it, or a work plane over it at any angle; its profile of lines, arcs and circles); regions; distance (how deep from the side of the sheet that looks at the sketch; default and at most Thickness: through). The profile is cut out of every flat face and bend of that side it is seen on, looking along the sketch's normal, and each is cut square to itself: a cut whose walls are square to the sheet whatever the angle of the sketch, so the flat pattern has one clean outline. (On a face parallel to the sketch it is the profile; at an angle, or on a bend, the profile as it is seen there.)

sketch.description: the sketch: its feature id, as sketch.create returns it

regions.description: the closed regions of the sketch to use, each as sketch.info lists it under `select`: [curve ids], or {left, right, nth} for one region of a divided sketch (default: every outer region)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Bend
commands.description: edges: [two edge references]: a straight edge of the rim of each of two faces of the sheet that do not touch (a face made apart from the rest is one), running alongside one another (for a sharp edge where two faces touch, see sheet.sharp_bend). The faces are joined by a bend along as much of the edges as lie side by side, each face trimmed or extended to where the bend begins. radius (inside; default BendRadius). Faces in planes that cross take one bend, tangent to both. Faces in parallel planes take two, as double says: "fix_edges" (default: two equal bends between the edges as they are), "45_degree" or "90_degree" (two bends of that angle and a face between them: side by side an S, one over the other a U at 90), "full_radius" (one over the other: half a circle, as wide inside as the faces are apart); flip_fixed (the second edge stays where it is and the first face is trimmed or extended, not the other way round)

edges.description: two edges: one of each of the two faces to join

radius.description: the inside bend radius (default: the rule's BendRadius)

double.description: for faces in parallel planes: how the two bends between them are made (default fix_edges)

flip_fixed.description: which of the two faces is trimmed or extended (default false: the second)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Bend on Sharp Edges
commands.description: edges: [edge references]: each the edge of a sharp corner where two faces of the sheet meet with no bend between them (the edges of a shelled box, say), its outside edge or its inside one. Every corner is cleared back to where a bend begins on either face, for the length of its edge, and the bend is put in, tangent to both faces, as far along the edge as both faces still reach it: the outer faces stay where they are. radius (inside; default BendRadius). Edges that meet at a corner of the sheet are given together: their bends then end where their bend lines cross. A bend whose end would lie against sheet that runs on beside it is refused: open that corner first (sheet.corner_rip)

edges.description: sharp edges where two faces of the sheet meet

radius.description: the inside bend radius (default: the rule's BendRadius)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

commands.label: Fold
commands.description: sketch (on a side of the sheet: a face of it, or a plane that lies on one) with a straight line across the face, from edge to edge; line: its id (default: the sketch's one line). The sheet on one side of the line stays, the bend takes its allowance of sheet at the line, and the rest turns with it: nothing is added. angle (rad, default a quarter turn); radius (inside; default BendRadius); location: "centerline" (default: the line is the middle of the bend) | "start" (the bend starts at the line) | "end"; flip_side (the other side of the line folds: as drawn, the side to its left seen from the sketch's side of the sheet); flip_direction (down, away from the sketch's side, not up towards it)

sketch.description: the sketch with the line to fold along, drawn across a face from edge to edge

line.description: which line (default: the sketch's only one)

angle.description: how far to fold (default a right angle)

radius.description: the inside bend radius (default: the rule's BendRadius)

location.description: where the bend lies relative to the line (default centerline)

flip_side.description: fold the other side of the line (default false)

equations.description: equations for values of the feature, by where the value is in its definition: {"/distance": "width / 2"} (lengths in mm, angles in degrees)

face.description: the face that lies up in the flat pattern; null for the part's own choice

commands.label: Flat Pattern
commands.description: The part laid flat: length and width (the sheet it is cut from), area, cut_length (round the outline and every hole), holes, and each bend's angle (rad), inside radius, allowance (its width in the flat), up (bent towards the A side) and centre lines. face: the A side (default: the part's, else the largest flat face); body (default: the only one); curves: true adds the outlines (outer, inner) as lines, arcs, circles and polylines

face.description: the face to lay flat from (default: the A side)

curves.description: also give the outline's curves (default false)

commands.label: Edge Reference
commands.description: faces: [face origin, face origin] (the two faces the edge joins); or at: [x, y, z], a point on the edge away from its ends; or body (default 0) and edge (index from model.edges)

faces.description: the two faces the edge lies between: face references, or their names

at.description: or a point [x, y, z] on the edge

edge.description: or the edge's number, as model.edges lists it

commands.label: Face Reference
commands.description: origin: {"type": "cap", "feature": id, "end": "start" | "end"} or {"type": "side", "feature": id, "curve": id}; or at: [x, y, z], a point inside the face; or body (default 0) and face (index from model.faces)

origin.description: the face's name: {"type": "cap", "feature": id, "end": "start" | "end"}, {"type": "side", "feature": id, "curve": sketch curve id} and so on, as model.faces lists them

at.description: or a point [x, y, z] on the face

face.description: or the face's number, as model.faces lists it

commands.label: Find Geometry
commands.description: Faces or edges of the part by what they are and where, each with a reference to it. what: faces | edges; body (default: every body); kind: plane | cylinder | cone | sphere | torus | other (faces), line | circle | arc | other (edges); facing: the way a flat face looks, as +x, -x, +y, -y, +z, -z, top, bottom, left, right, front, back or [x, y, z]; along: the direction of a straight edge, or of the axis of a round face or edge; feature: made by that feature; hole: true for the walls of holes, false for shafts; radius; most: of what is found, only the furthest that way (top, -x, ...), or the largest or smallest. Returns count and found: each with body, its number (face or edge), name, reference (null when it cannot be referred to yet), kind and its measures; and, when a feature fails, error (feature, message): what is found is then of the part as far as it rebuilt

body.description: only on this body (default: every body)

kind.description: what it is: plane, cylinder, cone, sphere, torus or other for faces; line, circle (a whole one), arc or other for edges

facing.description: flat faces that look this way: top, bottom, left, right, front, back, +x ... -z, or [x, y, z]

along.description: straight edges that run this way, and round faces and edges whose axis does (either way along it)

hole.description: round faces only: true for the walls of holes, false for shafts

radius.description: round faces and edges of this radius

most.description: of what is found, only the furthest this way (top, -x, [x, y, z] ...), or the largest or smallest; those level with it count too

commands.description: A box as two ordinary features: a sketch of a dimensioned rectangle, and its extrusion, made in one undo step. plane: xy | yz | xz (default xy), or face, or work_plane, as sketch.create; x, y: a corner in the sketch (default the origin), or with centered: true its centre; width (along the sketch's x), depth (along its y), height; operation (default join); reverse. Returns sketch, feature and their names

plane.description: the origin plane its sketch is on (default xy)

face.description: or a flat face to sketch on

work_plane.description: or a work plane's feature id

x.description: where it is in the sketch (default 0)

y.description: where it is in the sketch (default 0)

operation.description: what the feature does to the part (default join)

reverse.description: the other way from the sketch (default false)

commands.label: Sphere
commands.description: A sphere as two ordinary features: a sketch of a dimensioned circle with a centre line through it, and its revolution, made in one undo step. plane, face or work_plane, as sketch.create; x, y: its centre in the sketch (default the origin); diameter; operation (default join). Returns sketch, feature and their names

plane.description: the origin plane its sketch is on (default xy)

face.description: or a flat face to sketch on

work_plane.description: or a work plane's feature id

x.description: where it is in the sketch (default 0)

y.description: where it is in the sketch (default 0)

operation.description: what the feature does to the part (default join)

commands.label: Torus
commands.description: A torus as two ordinary features: a sketch of a dimensioned circle beside an axis, and its revolution, made in one undo step. plane, face or work_plane, as sketch.create (the ring stands square to it, about the sketch's upright); x, y: its centre in the sketch (default the origin); diameter: across the ring, from the middle of its section to the middle opposite; section: how thick the ring is; operation (default join). plane.description: the origin plane its sketch is on (default xy)

face.description: or a flat face to sketch on

y.description: where it is in the sketch (default 0)

Returns the sheet's length, width, area and cut_length, and what was written of the outlines (entities)
